description: The result handed back to the host when the user applies a column mapping in TmImportWizard. Carries both the chosen Mappings (which source column went to which target field) and the Rows re-projected onto the target field keys, with mapped values only and ignored columns omitted. This is a mapping payload, not a full import engine.

members.name: Mappings
members.description: The chosen column-to-field mappings, one per detected source column.

members.name: Rows
members.description: Data rows keyed by ImportTargetField.Key; a key is present only when a source column was mapped to it.
